raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The plot displays the training loss over iterations for several models, including a baseline "Vanilla" model and various configurations of "StrmLLM" and "SepLLM" models with different settings. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000 in increments of 20,000, and is labeled "#Iteration". The y-axis represents the loss, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale, and is labeled "Loss". All lines start at a loss of approximately 3.35 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decrease in loss. The "Vanilla" model (purple, solid line) decreases quickly and stabilizes around a loss of 2.5. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" model (blue, solid line) follows a similar trend, starting at 3.35 and decreasing to a loss of about 2.6. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model (orange, solid line) starts at 3.35 and decreases to a loss of approximately 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model (green, solid line) follows a similar trajectory, decreasing from 3.35 to a loss of about 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model (red, solid line) also starts at 3.35 and decreases to a loss of approximately 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model (dark blue, solid line) starts at 3.35 and decreases to a loss of about 2.55. All models show a general downward trend in loss, with the loss values converging towards lower values as the number of iterations increases.
